design_description: A classic white, deep red and gold football jersey built around a strong central stripe. A wide red vertical panel runs from collar to hem, finished with thin gold borders and a subtle tonal chevron pattern inside that adds texture up close while reading as solid red from distance. The shoulders and sleeves are deep red, with gold double shoulder stripes and restrained gold trim continuing around the collar and cuffs. The white side sections keep the design clean and give the central panel room to dominate, while the gold team wordmark stretches across the chest. The back becomes predominantly white with red sleeves and side detailing, leaving a large open area for identification. It is finished with a large metallic-gold name and number that stands out cleanly against the white base. Overall it has a traditional European football look with a refined, premium colour palette: white for space, deep red for structure and gold used sparingly as the finishing detail rather than as a third block colour.
